# cairn share revoke

Revoke a previously minted share link

## Help

Options:
      --link-id <ID>          Stable share-link id to revoke (e.g. share-01HZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ)
      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>  Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides
